auth.toSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.inviteOnly: New accounts need an invite from this server's admin.
auth.forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Ask this server's admin for a reset link.

welcome.usernameHint: 3 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, digits, _ and .

book.createIntro: Each book is a separate set of accounts, such as Personal or Household.
book.name: Book name
book.currencyHint: The book's totals are shown in this currency.
book.deleteBody: Every account, category and transaction in "{{name}}" will be deleted for good. This can't be undone.
book.deleteConfirmLabel: Type the book's name to confirm
book.ownerOnly: Only an owner can change the settings.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Tap Add account to create your first one.
accounts.name: Account name
accounts.currencyLocked: The currency can't change once the account has transactions.
accounts.last4Hint: Never enter a full card or account number.
accounts.inNetWorthHint: Turn off for money you hold for someone else. Spending from it still counts.
accounts.balanceHint: Changing it adds an adjustment transaction for the difference, dated today.
accounts.interestHint: For reference only: interest isn't added to the balance. Add a transaction when you receive or pay it.
accounts.installmentFeeHint: A one-off fee, added once, to the first payment (0 % installment contracts often have one).

bill.needsCard: Add the statement day and the payment due day (Edit) to see this month's bill.
bill.needsLoan: Add the monthly installment and the payment day (Edit) to see this month's installment.
bill.interestPart: {{amount}} of it is the month's interest, recorded as an expense on the loan; the loan goes down by the rest.
bill.feePart: The installment fee, {{amount}}, is charged with this payment, once.
bill.noAccounts: No account in {{currency}} to pay from. Add one, or pay with an ordinary transfer.

errors.not_signed_in: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.conflict: This was just changed somewhere else. It's been reloaded; please try again.
errors.invalid: Something isn't filled in correctly. Please check.
errors.name_taken: That name is already used in this book.
errors.currency_locked: The currency can't change once the account has transactions.
errors.no_rate: There's no exchange rate yet to convert the book's currency.
errors.owner_required: A book needs at least one owner. Make someone else owner first.
errors.amount: The amount isn't in the right format.
errors.unexpected_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.has_subcategories: This category still has sub-categories. Move or delete them first.
errors.txn_shape: This transaction isn't valid: check the amounts and accounts.
errors.category_kind: Transfers take only transfer categories, and the other way round.
errors.budget_exists: This category already has a budget for that period.
errors.budget_expense_only: Budgets go on expense categories only.
errors.not_restorable: It's been more than 30 days; the account can't be restored.
errors.invalid_code: That code is wrong or expired. Try a new one.
errors.code_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.invite_invalid: This invite code is wrong, used, revoked or expired. Ask the admin for a new one.
errors.invite_required: This server takes new accounts by invite only.
errors.setup_invalid: Wrong setup code, or this server is already set up.
errors.reset_invalid: This reset link is wrong, used or expired. Ask the admin for a new one.
errors.admin_only: Only this server's admin can do this.
errors.admin_self: You can't disable your own account.
errors.invalid_timezone: That timezone isn't one this server knows. Pick another.
errors.updater_off: One-click updates are off on this server.
errors.origin_not_allowed: This address isn't this server's own web app.
errors.cannot_invite: No one with that username can be invited: check the spelling, or they may already be in this book.
errors.server_unreachable: Can't reach the server. If it's restarting or updating, try again in a few minutes.

txn.title: Transactions
txn.adjustmentHint: Enter a negative number to lower the balance.
txn.needTwoAccounts: A transfer needs at least two accounts.

cat.title: Categories
cat.name: Category name
cat.transferHint: Transfer categories are labels only: they never count as spending.
cat.archivedInstead: This category has transactions, so it was archived instead of deleted.

people.title: People you lend to or borrow from
people.name: Name
people.noteHint: Only a name and a note are kept about this person, nothing else.
people.archivedInstead: This person is linked to an account, so they were archived instead of deleted.
people.lendHint: Lending or getting paid back is a transfer between this account and one of yours.

dash.title: Overview
dash.missingRates_one: {{count}} account has no exchange rate yet, so it isn't counted.
dash.missingRates_other: {{count}} accounts have no exchange rate yet, so they aren't counted.
dash.notConverted_one: {{count}} transaction has no exchange rate yet, so it isn't counted.
dash.notConverted_other: {{count}} transactions have no exchange rate yet, so they aren't counted.
dash.empty: Add accounts and transactions to see your overview.
dash.pinHint: Pin accounts on Accounts to choose these.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.setupStep1: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, or enter the key below.
mfa.setupStep2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows to finish.
mfa.enabled: On. Every sign-in needs a code from your authenticator app.
mfa.disableConfirm: Turn off two-step verification? Enter a code from your authenticator app to confirm.
mfa.newCodesConfirm: The old recovery codes stop working. Enter a code from your authenticator app to continue.
mfa.recoveryBody: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe; they won't be shown again.

profile.title: Profile and security
profile.themeHint: On this device. Unless you pick one, it follows the device's own setting.
profile.devicesHint: Where this account is signed in. Sign out a device you no longer use, or every other one at once.
profile.exportHint: Download all your data as readable CSV files in one ZIP file.
profile.deleteHint: Your account closes now and is deleted for good after 30 days. You can restore it until then. Download your data first if you need it.
profile.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices are signed out.
profile.idleSignOutHint: On every device: after this long with no click, key or touch, you're signed out, with a warning a minute before.

closing.title: Your account is closing
closing.body: Your account will be deleted for good on {{date}}. Until then you can restore it and everything will be as it was.

join.title: Join
join.intro: Enter the invite code from this server's admin, then choose a username and password.
join.introOpen: Choose a username and password. An invite code is optional on this server.
join.codeHint: Like X7K2-9QPM. Filled in for you when you open the invite link.

setup.title: Set up this server
setup.intro: This server has no admin yet. The admin can invite people, reset their passwords and change the server's settings.
setup.codeHint: Printed in the server's log: run docker compose logs msaving on the machine it runs on.
setup.serverNameHint: Shown on the sign-in screen, for example "Nhà Lan".

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: This link from the admin works once. Two-step verification is turned off; turn it on again in Profile.

admin.title: Server admin
admin.signupHint: With invites only, you decide who joins.
admin.signupOpen: Anyone who can open this server
admin.invitesHint: An invite lets one person create an account. Send them the link, or let them scan the QR code.
admin.inviteReadyBody: Send this link, or let them scan the code. It works once, until {{date}}.
admin.resetReadyBody: Give this link to them yourself. It works once, for 24 hours, and turns their two-step verification off.
admin.updateByHand: To update, run these on the server, in the msaving folder (the one you cloned):
admin.updaterHint: For a one-click Update here, add COMPOSE_PROFILES=updater to .env (see the setup guide: it gives a helper control of Docker).
admin.updateConfirm: Install version {{version}}? The server builds it, takes a backup, then restarts; everyone is offline for a moment, and the whole update takes a few minutes.
admin.updatingReload: Updating to {{version}}. The server rebuilds and restarts, so this page may stop working for a few minutes. Reload it in about 5 minutes.
admin.updatedReload: Updated to {{version}}. Reload the page to use the new version.
admin.jobsHint: Each runs once a day at its time, in your timezone ({{timezone}}). One missed while the server was off runs when it starts again.

jobNames.purge: Delete closed accounts and old sign-ins

admin.jobOff: Off: rates stay as they are

members.title: Members
members.intro: People on this server who keep this book with you. They see everything in it.
members.invited: Invited {{name}}. They'll see the invite when they sign in.
members.roles: Owner: everything, including members and settings. Editor: adds and changes accounts, transactions, categories and budgets. Viewer: can only look.
members.removeBody: {{name}} will no longer see "{{book}}". What they added stays in the book.
members.leaveBody: You'll no longer see "{{book}}". An owner can invite you again.
members.invitedYou: {{who}} invited you to the book "{{book}}" as {{role}}.

idle.title: Still there?
idle.warning: You'll be signed out in {{seconds}} seconds, as nothing has happened here for a while.
idle.signedOut: You were signed out after {{minutes}} minutes without activity.
